task.description:
Run all tests for API-09 (Request tracing) and produce a test report.

Steps:
1. Implement integration tests specified in tests/specs/API-09.md (TC-API-09-INT-01 through INT-06) in tests/integration/trace_test.zig if not already present
2. Run unit tests: zig build test
3. Run integration tests: zig build test-integration (requires BPM_TEST_DB_URL)
4. Write a test report to tests/reports/API-09-test-report.md

The report must include:
- Pass/fail for each test case (TC-API-09-01 through TC-API-09-10 unit, TC-API-09-INT-01 through INT-06 integration)
- Any issues found with severity classification
- Overall PASS or FAIL verdict
acceptance_criteria: All 10 unit tests (TC-API-09-01 through TC-API-09-10) pass
All 6 integration tests (TC-API-09-INT-01 through TC-API-09-INT-06) pass or are documented as deferred

result.summary: All 10 unit tests (TC-API-09-01 through TC-API-09-10) pass. 6 integration tests implemented in tests/integration/trace_test.zig; deferred because the HTTP server is not yet implemented (BPM_TEST_URL not set).

issues.description: 6 HTTP-layer integration tests (TC-API-09-INT-01 through INT-06) deferred — HTTP server not yet implemented. Tests are complete and will execute when BPM_TEST_URL is set.
